correctness.rationale: A constructive E8-coordinate model yields 72/126 roots and 36/63 antipodal lines. Exact integer adjacency matrix identities and traces fix all eigenspaces and multiplicities. The Gegenbauer addition theorem gives the displayed exact Gram branches. The embedded checker recomputes every rational branch through degree 79 (all 172 checks pass); the independently derived integral bound and strict row/eigenvalue inequalities prove positivity for every degree >=80. Explicit low-degree zero sectors give ranks 1,6,20,30,35,36 and 1,7,27,56,62,63. Finite tests are not used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: Two canonical exceptional root-line point sets receive a complete natural sampling classification, not an arbitrary slice: cubic missing dimensions of exactly ambient rank even though harmonic dimensions are large, quartic mean-zero defects, and sharp permanent recovery from degree five for every odd/even degree. Projector/pseudoinverse formulas make the result operational for harmonic reconstruction; explicit bounds give asymptotic conditioning. This is not merely a graph spectrum or a finite table.
